titleByLocale.it: Stage per mansioni di manutenzione e magazzino
titleByLocale.fr: Stagiaire pour les tâches de maintenance et de stockage

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Etsimme kesäharjoittelijaa huollon ja varaston tehtäviin Sulzerin Vantaan toimipisteeseen. Harjoittelussa pääset tekemään käytännönläheistä työtä Sulzer/ABS uppopumppujen ja pumppaamojen parissa niin korjaamolla ja varastolla kuin asiakaskohteissa. Käyttökohteet liittyvät vesilaitosten sekä kiinteistöjen jäte , perus ja sadevesipumppauksiin.
Mitä odotammme sinulta?

• Sähkö‑ tai konealan koulutustaustaa (esim. opiskelija)

• Sujuvaa ohjelmistojen hallintaa (Sulzerilla käytössä SAP-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä)

• B‑ajokorttia

• Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia

• Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä englannin kielen perustaitoa

Tehtävän palkka sijoittuu 11 – 13 e/h välille. Lopullinen palkka määräytyy valitun henkilön kokemuksen ja osaamisen perusteella. Palkkahaarukka vastaa tehtävän suunniteltua vastuutasoa.

Kiinnostuitko? Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palvelupäällikkö Pekka Miilumäki, puh +358 50 331 3484. Jätäthän hakemuksesi viimeistään 28.5.2026 mennessä!

What we offer you

Mitä tarjoamme?

• Mahdollisuuden työskennellä huippuluokan tuotteiden parissa tunnetun ja arvostetun tuotemerkin alla

• Asiantuntevan ja kannustavan työyhteisön tuen

• Turvallisen ja hyvin organisoidun työympäristön

• Käytännönläheisen oppimiskokemuksen huollon ja varaston tehtävissä

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Repair Center Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Repair Center Coordinator is responsible for supporting equipment repair project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support. Key Responsibilities

• Assist in developing project plans, schedules, and estimates.

• Monitor project progress and report on milestones.

• Provide technical and analytical support to project teams.

• Ensure adherence to quality and safety standards.

• Liaise with users to gather and document requirements.

• Support vendor coordination and deliverable tracking.

Skills & Qualifications

• Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

• Solid understanding of project management principles.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Effective communication and teamwork.

• Familiarity with project planning tools.

• Ability to work independently with general supervision.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Deputy Regional Manager – North/Central China
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of junior sales staff, ensuring daily sales operations run smoothly, and supporting the achievement of sales targets. This role provides coaching, monitors performance, and ensures compliance with company policies. Job Responsibilities

• Supervise sales team in daily work to achieve sales target .

• Provide training and support to new hires.

• Ensure adherence to sales processes and policies.

• Handle customer issues and escalate when necessary.

• Track and report team performance.

• Coordinates sales effort with marketing, sales management, procurement, costing, logistics and engineering to make the sales target .
Qualifications

• Typically a University degree and 6+ years of relevant work experience are minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.

• Experience in sales or customer service supervision.

• Strong communication and leadership skills.

• Ability to motivate and coach team members.

• Familiarity with CRM systems and sales reporting.

• Problem-solving and organizational abilities.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role leads the Field Service & Engineering organization with full responsibility for the planning, execution, and documentation of field jobs, services, and projects. The position ensures delivery in line with defined scope, timelines, and budgets, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and quality.
By leading the local center of competence, the role strengthens regional capabilities, reduces reliance on global mobilization, shortens response times, and ultimately enhances customer satisfaction and profitable service delivery.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead global field service execution, including outages, overhauls, inspections, troubleshooting, and commissioning

• Own global service performance, covering safety, quality, schedule adherence, cost, margins, and customer satisfaction

• Drive the regionalization of field services by developing local skills, certifications, tools, and standardized execution practices

• Define and implement the regional field service operating model in line with global policies and standards

• Act as the primary customer interface during service execution and support Sales & Tendering with execution concepts, feasibility reviews, and cost inputs

• Lead and develop local and regional Field Service Engineers and Supervisors, fostering a strong safety culture and service mindset

• Plan and optimize regional resources, coordinating cross‑regional support only where specialized expertise or peak capacity is required

• Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and compliance with global EHS and quality requirements, while feeding field learnings back into global organizations

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• 10+ years of experience in field service or service operations within turbomachinery, power generation, or rotating equipment

• Proven leadership experience managing multi‑disciplinary field service teams

• Strong background in outage execution, maintenance, and troubleshooting

• Experience with regionalization, localization, or operating model transformation is highly desirable

• Strong safety leadership, customer focus, and cost‑ and risk‑aware decision‑making skills

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Center Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Service Center Administrator plays a critical role in supporting daily operations within a fast-paced service environment. This position is responsible for coordinating purchase orders, managing logistics, supporting work order processes, and maintaining accurate system transactions across multiple platforms (Salesforce and SAP). The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable wearing many hats in an unstructured, dynamic setting. Key Responsibilities

• Order & Procurement Management
• Process and manage purchase orders (POs) in Salesforce and SAP

• Receive and review POs for direct materials

• Create, place, and receive POs for indirect materials

• Establish vendor terms and maintain supplier communications

• Logistics & Operations Coordination
• Arrange transportation and logistics for pumps and related equipment

• Track materials and ensure timely delivery to support operations

• Perform receipt transactions and maintain accurate inventory records

• Work Order & Job Coordination
• Release, track, and manage work orders throughout the lifecycle

• Book jobs and ensure accurate scheduling within system tools

• Maintain status management and provide updates on work order progress

• Customer & Vendor Interaction
• Greet and assist customers and vendors in a professional manner

• Serve as a key point of contact for inquiries related to orders and services

• Financial & System Transactions
• Process invoicing activities within SAP

• Ensure accurate data entry and documentation across all systems

• Support booking and job costing activities as needed

Qualifications

• Experience coordinating purchase orders and logistics in a service or industrial environment

• Familiarity with ERP/CRM systems such as SAP and Salesforce

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, unstructured environment

• Proactive mindset with strong attention to detail

• Excellent communication and customer service skills

Key Competencies

• Adaptability and flexibility (“wear many hats”)

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Time management and prioritization

• Attention to detail and accuracy

• Team-oriented with a customer-first approach

Work Environment

• Fast-paced, operations-focused service center

• Dynamic and evolving priorities

• Hands-on role requiring interaction across multiple functions

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Works Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
oversees the tendering and execution phases of projects by defining methodologies, resources, and schedules, serving as the main technical liaison with clients, and ensuring scope, quality, time, and cost objectives are met. Main tasks and responsibilities
During TENDERING PROCESS:

• Technical coordinator in detailed step/methodology, identification of the required tools, equipment and manpower.

• Point of contact between the potential client and Sulzer team for technical details, data collection, analysis, possible root causes in order to avoid reoccurrence after repair by Sulzer.

• Create Planning/schedule from mobilization, execution, testing and commissioning up to Owner’s acceptance and document submission.
During PROJECT EXECUTION:

• Project Manager roles, i.e. to manage scope, quality, time and cost of the project

• Sourcing possible local resources of skilled manpower, tools, equipment, workshop

• Attending meeting with the Client, provide response for their inquires, comments and concerns.

• Coordinate/ discuss with the respective Sulzer’s team/ division.

• Supervision of Sulzer’s team and subcontractor at site

• Project progress internal meeting and report
Technical support In developing Sulzer Philippines Service Center facility and organization

• Service center design review, construction supervision and testing of each installed equipment.

• Assess the local demand/need of further expansion of facilities

• Involve in the hiring process, training and supervision of the technical team.

• Establish Quality Control documents, procedures, reporting and documentation system.

• Create a high quality product/services to the customer’s satisfaction that will support Sulzer’s business expansion in the Philippines.

• Build and maintain close connection with client and potential client, to be able to provide a solution when needed.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Proficiency in project planning and scheduling tools

• Skilled in root cause analysis and troubleshooting techniques.

• Ability to source and manage local manpower, tools, and equipment.

• Strong client relationship management

• Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken) for coordination with global teams.

• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

• Willingness to travel and work on project sites.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering

• Having >5 years experience as a manager, mainly in repairing rotating equipment

• Having knowledge in maintenance and overhaul of rotating equipment, such as turbine, compressor, generator

• Proven track record as a Project Manager or Technical Coordinator in repair, maintenance, or commissioning projects.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Medical benefit
Saving Plan

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
To provide hands-on technical assistance in the repair and maintenance of various equipment in the workshop or at the customer sites. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Overhaul and repair of Various type of Turbine, gear boxes, pumps, compressors, and associated other equipment such auxiliary

• Installs rotating equipment including those requiring non-standard installation procedures. Make necessary alignment/adjustment to ensure correct operation.

• Removes & dismantles equipment with maintenance problems; cleans & lubricate; repairs/replace faulty components; reassembles units and checks for efficient operation. Performs preventive & breakdown maintenance jobs.

• Uses a variety of testing equipment to diagnose trouble in proper sequence. Also, uses tools such as hydraulic press, pullers, electric drills, grinders, heating torch as well as precision tools such as micrometer, caliper gauges & dial gauges for test-checking or repair work.

• Performs/ensures maintenance work in accordance with instructions, drawings and codes of practice.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?

• Requirement: minimum vocational high background: Automotive and Machining.

• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall maintenance. Familiar with measuring tools, and general tools.

• Familiar with Assembly drawing, symbols and legend.

• Familiar with relevant standard such as API, NEMA, codes, and rules of thumbs

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Fresh Graduate are welcome., 1–2-year experience in machinist role or automotive mechanic is preferred

• Production Knowledge: Precision Measuring tools/instrument such as Dial Gage, OD micrometres, ID micrometre, Callipers etc and math calculation.

• Familiar with Computer. Familiar with Drawing Software is a Plus. Hand Sketches is preferable.

• Proficient in English Language verbal and in written-Having certificate in English communication such as TOEIC is a plus.

• Basic Mechanical such as Lifting and Rigging, Metal and Alloys, Bearings, Welding, Production Processes and Shaft Alignment

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Medical Benefit Saving Plan

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Job Summary
This role supports the execution of functional strategies, identifies opportunities for operational optimization, and ensures the delivery of high-impact business development projects. Job responsibilities

• Be responsible for driving strategy, sales growth, specially grow non CHD business in China.

• Be responsible for developing and maintaining partnerships with JV partner, within Sulzer and with external stakeholders.

• Ensure for the JV the deal structuring, pricing and all other proposal development activities interfacing with related Sulzer organizations, systems and product platform.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement strategic initiatives and monitor progress.

• Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations in all business development activities.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree, majored in Turbine or related engineering.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in a global industrial company lead sales management functions.

• Strong background in the Energy market focused on Solution selling and services and in particular Heavy Duty Gas Turbine Services.

• Strong negotiation, communication skills and influence.

• Good knowledge and experience in Gas Turbine technology.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in België en Nederland en is in deze regio met bijna 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer Flow als Workshop Technician (monteur) - Meewerkend voorman (m/v/x) en help mee om onze service naar een next level te brengen.

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, with over 180 years of innovation, operating across more than 160 locations worldwide and generating annual revenues in excess of CHF 3.5 billion.. Within our Services legal entity, we specialise in the maintenance, repair, upgrade, and optimisation of rotating equipment such as pumps, turbines, motors, and compressors. We work with customers across energy, oil & gas, chemicals, water, and industrial sectors to keep essential infrastructure running efficiently, reliably, and sustainably—reducing downtime, extending asset life, and improving performance worldwide. As we continue to strengthen our global operations, we are now seeking a Global Operational Excellence Development Manager to help drive transformation across our international service network, embedding best practice, improving efficiency, and enhancing customer experience at scale.
In this role you will be accountable for:

• Lead and roll out global operational excellence initiatives across our Services business

• Drive process standardisation, optimisation, and digitalisation across end-to-end value chains

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve customer experience, efficiency, and profitability

• Partner with stakeholders across regions to translate strategy into execution

• Deliver medium to large-scale transformation projects in a global, decentralised organisation

• Champion Lean methodologies and a continuous improvement mindset

• Develop frameworks, tools, and governance to sustain operational excellence

• Collaborate across Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience in Operational Excellence / Continuous Improvement / Operations Management

• Proven delivery of projects in international, matrix organisations

• Strong knowledge of process optimisation, Lean principles, and value chain improvement

• Experience with process digitalisation and IT-enabled transformation

• Understanding of business process modelling frameworks

• Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills

• Familiarity with ERP (SAP/D365) and CRM systems

• Background in industrial services, manufacturing, or engineering is preferred

Desirable:

• Service business experience

• Strategy / Management consulting background

• Exposure to rotating equipment or industrial markets

What we offer you

• A hybrid role with occasional travel across regions (30–40% global travel)

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance for yourself and partner through Aviva.

• The option of a company car or cash allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Afri

titleByLocale.fr: Technicien de service sur le terrain

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Servicetekniker till Servicecentret, CSS Stockholm Servicetekniker till Servicecentret, CSS Stockholm

Sulzer är ett globalt ledande företag inom utveckling och leverans av pumpar, omrörare, luftarutrustning och blåsmaskiner till kunder inom områden som olja, gas, vatten, vattenrening gruvdrift, pappersindustri och liknande. Vi tillhandahåller en utmanande och givande arbetsmiljö där mångfald är värderad som nyckelfaktorn till framgång.

Vi söker en servicetekniker till vårt servicecenter i Stockholm. Vi erbjuder en intressant tjänst med goda möjligheter för vidare utveckling. Vårt huvudkontor ligger i Vadstena och vi har även kontor i Malmö, Göteborg, Norrköping och Stockholm samt service centers i Vadstena, Göteborg, Årsta, Järfälla, Karlstad, Arlöv och Piteå. Placeringsort för denna roll är Årsta.

Tjänsten:

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Automation Engineering team within Chemtech division in Switzerland as Process Automation & Instrumentation Engineer to help us take our customer's experience to the next level.
In this role you will be accountable for:

• Elaboration of specifications, inquiries and ordering of all Electrical, Instrumentation and Control engineering components

• Design of loop diagrams

• Design and testing of automation solutions for our process plants

• Installation supervision and approval of plants in our production

• Sales support during the tendering phase

• Instrumentation support during commissioning of plants mainly in Europe

• Travel within Europe, approx. 10%

To succeed in this role you will need:

• A Master Degree in Mechatronics / electrical engineering / instrumentation / industrial automation or an equivalent education and ideally several years of experience in the ATEX area and process automation

• to be specialized in the specification of components for instruments and control systems

• to have practical experience in Siemens TIA Portal, as well as commission of chemical plants in hazardous areas

• to be fluent in German / English. French is a plus

• to be able to work independently, you are flexible and reliable, you identify yourself as communicative, goal and team-oriented and you are willing to travel occasionally, proactive and open for change in a dynamic and exciting field.

What we offer you

• 25 days holiday (excluding bank holidays and service days)

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program

• Access to a wide range of discounts on Everyday Shopping, Entertainment and Lifestyle

• Long service awards

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Application & Tendering Engineer is responsible for developing technical and commercial solutions for municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, supporting the preparation of competitive bids and tenders.
The role combines process understanding, application engineering, and tendering activities, with a strong focus on selecting, designing, and integrating treatment technologies based on customer requirements, project constraints, and applicable standards.
The engineer acts as a technical interface between Sales, Engineering, and external stakeholders, contributing to solution definition from early tender stage through project handover. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Tendering & Proposal Development

• Analyze RFQs, tender documents, and technical specifications related to wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) , both civil and industrial .

• Develop complete technical and commercial proposals , ensuring compliance with process requirements, client expectations, and internal guidelines.

• Coordinate with internal departments (process engineering, mechanical engineering, procurement, finance, projects) to collect inputs for bids.

• Perform cost estimation, material take-offs, and preparation of BOQs for water and wastewater treatment solutions.

• Ensure timely and accurate submission of tenders and clarification responses.

Application Engineering & Process Support

• Provide pre-sales technical and process support to Sales and customers.

• Define and recommend process solutions and equipment for:

• Preliminary and primary treatment

• Secondary (biological) treatment

• Tertiary and polishing steps

• Sludge treatment and handling (where applicable)

• Size and configure treatment units and packages (e.g. screens, grit removal, clarification, filtration, sludge equipment).

• Prepare process descriptions, technical datasheets, layouts, and technical clarifications .

• Support and participate in technical meetings, workshops, and presentations with customers, consultants, EPC contractors, and authorities.

Client, Consultant & Vendor Interface

• Liaise with clients, consultants, technology partners, and EPC contractors to clarify process and technical aspects during the tender phase.

• Interface with suppliers and manufacturers to obtain quotations, technical data, and delivery information.

• Align technical solutions with international standards and specifications (e.g. EN, ISO, local standards, project-specific requirements).

Post‑Bid Support & Project Handover

• Follow up on submitted tenders and support post‑bid technical clarifications and negotiations .

• Contribute to contract review from a technical and scope-of-supply perspective .

• Ensure a structured handover of awarded projects to the execution team, including all technical, commercial, and process documentation.

Organizational & Knowledge Sharing

• Support and mentor junior application or tendering engineers .

• Contribute to standardization of technical solutions, tools, and templates .

• Share know‑how on wastewater treatment technologies and applications within the organization.

REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering (with clear exposure to water/wastewater treatment).

• 4–7 years of experience in application engineering, tendering, or technical sales within the water and wastewater treatment sector .

• Proven experience with municipal and/or industrial wastewater treatment processes .

• Strong understanding of treatment technologies, plant layouts, and process interfaces .

• Experience in tenders for EPC or public sector projects is a strong advantage.

Technical & Professional Skills

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo L'Application & Tendering Engineer è responsabile dello sviluppo di soluzioni tecniche e commerciali per impianti di trattamento delle acque reflue municipali e industriali, supportando la preparazione di offerte e gare d'appalto. Il ruolo combina la comprensione dei processi, l'ingegneria delle applicazioni e le attività di gara, con una forte attenzione alla selezione, progettazione e integrazione delle tecnologie di trattamento in base ai requisiti del cliente, ai vincoli di progetto e agli standard applicabili. L'ingegnere funge da interfaccia tecnica tra le vendite, l'ingegneria e le parti interessate esterne, contribuendo alla definizione della soluzione dalla fase iniziale della gara fino alla consegna del progetto. RESPONSABILITÀ CHIAVE: Sviluppo di gare d'appalto e proposte
• Analizzare richieste di offerta, documenti di gara e specifiche tecniche relative agli impianti di trattamento delle acque reflue (WWTP), sia civili che industriali.
• Sviluppare proposte tecniche e commerciali complete, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti di processo, delle aspettative del cliente e delle linee guida interne.
• Coordinarsi con i dipartimenti interni (ingegneria di processo, ingegneria meccanica, appalti, finanza, progetti) per raccogliere input per le offerte.
• Eseguire la stima dei costi, i computi dei materiali e la preparazione dei BOQ per le soluzioni di trattamento dell'acqua e delle acque reflue.
• Garantire la presentazione tempestiva e accurata delle offerte e delle risposte di chiarimento. Ingegneria applicativa e supporto ai processi
• Fornire supporto tecnico e di processo prevendita alle vendite e ai clienti.
• Definire e consigliare soluzioni di processo e attrezzature per:
• Trattamento preliminare e primario
• Trattamento secondario (biologico)
• Fasi terziarie e di lucidatura
• Trattamento e movimentazione dei fanghi (ove applicabile)
• Dimensionare e configurare unità e pacchetti di trattamento (ad esempio vagli, rimozione della sabbia, chiarificazione, filtrazione, apparecchiature per i fanghi).
• Preparare descrizioni di processo, schede tecniche, layout e chiarimenti tecnici.
• Supportare e partecipare a riunioni tecniche, workshop e presentazioni con clienti, consulenti, appaltatori EPC e autorità. Interfaccia con clienti, consulenti e fornitori
• Collaborare con clienti, consulenti, partner tecnologici e appaltatori EPC per chiarire il processo e gli aspetti tecnici durante la fase di gara.
• Interfaccia con fornitori e produttori per ottenere preventivi, dati tecnici e informazioni sulla consegna.
• Allineare le soluzioni tecniche agli standard e alle specifiche internazionali (ad esempio EN, ISO, standard locali, requisiti specifici del progetto). Supporto post-offerta e consegna del progetto
• Seguire le offerte presentate e supportare chiarimenti tecnici e negoziazioni post-offerta.
• Contribuire alla revisione del contratto dal punto di vista tecnico e dell'ambito della fornitura.
• Garantire una consegna strutturata dei progetti aggiudicati al team di esecuzione, inclusa tutta la documentazione tecnica, commerciale e di processo. Condivisione organizzativa e delle conoscenze
• Supportare e guidare gli ingegneri junior che si occupano di candidature o gare d'appalto.
• Contribuire alla standardizzazione di soluzioni tecniche, strumenti e modelli.
• Condividere il know-how sulle tecnologie e sulle applicazioni per il trattamento delle acque reflue all'interno dell'organizzazione. REQUISITI Qualifiche ed esperienza
• Laurea triennale o magistrale in ingegneria ambientale, chimica, meccanica o civile (con chiara esposizione al trattamento delle acque/acque reflue).
• 4–7 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria applicativa, nelle gare d'appalto o nelle vendite tecniche nel settore del trattamento delle acque e delle acque reflue.
• Comprovata esperienza con processi di trattamento delle acque reflue municipali e/o industriali.
• Conoscenza approfondita delle tecnologie di trattamento, della disposizione degli impianti e delle interfacce di processo.
• L'esperienza in gare d'appalto per progetti EPC o del settore pubblico costituisce un forte vantaggio. Competenze tecniche e professionali
• Capacità di tradurre il processo r

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einer stolzen Tradition der Innovation. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Der Anwendungs- und Ausschreibungsingenieur ist für die Entwicklung technischer und kommerzieller Lösungen für kommunale und industrielle Abwasseraufbereitungsanlagen verantwortlich und unterstützt die Erstellung wettbewerbsfähiger Angebote und Ausschreibungen. Die Rolle kombiniert Prozessverständnis, Anwendungstechnik und Ausschreibungsaktivitäten mit einem starken Fokus auf die Auswahl, Gestaltung und Integration von Behandlungstechnologien basierend auf Kundenanforderungen, Projektbeschränkungen und geltenden Standards. Der Ingenieur fungiert als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Technik und externen Stakeholdern und trägt von der frühen Angebotsphase bis zur Projektübergabe zur Lösungsdefinition bei. HAUPTVERANTWORTLICHKEITEN: Ausschreibung und Angebotsentwicklung
• Analyse von Angebotsanfragen, Ausschreibungsunterlagen und technischen Spezifikationen im Zusammenhang mit Abwasseraufbereitungsanlagen (WWTPs), sowohl für zivile als auch für industrielle Zwecke.
• Entwickeln Sie vollständige technische und kommerzielle Vorschläge und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Prozessanforderungen, Kundenerwartungen und internen Richtlinien eingehalten werden.
• Koordinieren Sie sich mit internen Abteilungen (Verfahrenstechnik, Maschinenbau, Beschaffung, Finanzen, Projekte), um Eingaben für Angebote zu sammeln.
• Führen Sie Kostenschätzungen, Materialentnahmen und die Vorbereitung von BOQs für Wasser- und Abwasseraufbereitungslösungen durch.
• Gewährleisten Sie die rechtzeitige und korrekte Einreichung von Angeboten und Klärungsantworten. Anwendungstechnik und Prozessunterstützung
• Bereitstellung technischer und prozessbezogener Unterstützung vor dem Verkauf für Vertrieb und Kunden.
• Definieren und empfehlen Sie Prozesslösungen und Ausrüstung für:
• Vor- und Primärbehandlung
• Sekundäre (biologische) Behandlung
• Tertiär- und Polierschritte
• Schlammbehandlung und -handhabung (sofern zutreffend)
• Größe und Konfiguration von Behandlungseinheiten und -paketen (z. B. Siebe, Sandentfernung, Klärung, Filtration, Schlammausrüstung).
• Bereiten Sie Prozessbeschreibungen, technische Datenblätter, Layouts und technische Erläuterungen vor.
• Unterstützen Sie technische Meetings, Workshops und Präsentationen mit Kunden, Beratern, EPC-Auftragnehmern und Behörden und nehmen Sie daran teil. Kunden-, Berater- und Lieferantenschnittstelle
• Nehmen Sie Kontakt zu Kunden, Beratern, Technologiepartnern und EPC-Auftragnehmern auf, um prozessbezogene und technische Aspekte während der Ausschreibungsphase zu klären.
• Schnittstelle zu Lieferanten und Herstellern, um Angebote, technische Daten und Lieferinformationen zu erhalten.
• Technische Lösungen an internationalen Standards und Spezifikationen ausrichten (z. B. EN, ISO, lokale Standards, projektspezifische Anforderungen). Unterstützung nach der Ausschreibung und Projektübergabe
• Weiterverfolgung der eingereichten Angebote und Unterstützung bei technischen Klärungen und Verhandlungen nach der Ausschreibung.
• Tragen Sie zur Vertragsprüfung aus technischer Sicht und aus Sicht des Lieferumfangs bei.
• Sorgen Sie für eine strukturierte Übergabe der vergebenen Projekte an das Ausführungsteam, einschließlich aller technischen, kaufmännischen und prozessbezogenen Dokumentationen. Organisation und Wissensaustausch
• Unterstützen und betreuen Sie junge Anwendungs- oder Ausschreibungsingenieure.
• Tragen Sie zur Standardisierung technischer Lösungen, Tools und Vorlagen bei.
• Wissen über Abwasserbehandlungstechnologien und -anwendungen innerhalb der Organisation weitergeben. ANFORDERUNGEN Qualifikationen und Erfahrung
• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Umwelt-, Chemie-, Maschinenbau- oder Bauingenieurwesen (mit eindeutiger Erfahrung in der Wasser-/Abwasseraufbereitung).
• 4–7 Jahre Erfahrung in der Anwendungstechnik, Ausschreibung oder im technischen Vertrieb im Bereich Wasser- und Abwasseraufbereitung.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit kommunalen und/oder industriellen Abwasserbehandlungsprozessen.
• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von Aufbereitungstechnologien, Anlagenlayouts und Prozessschnittstellen.
• Erfahrung in Ausschreibungen für EPC- oder öffentliche Projekte sind von großem Vorteil. Technische und berufliche Fähigkeiten
• Fähigkeit, Prozesse zu übersetzen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie leader avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. À propos du rôle L'ingénieur d'application et d'appel d'offres est responsable du développement de solutions techniques et commerciales pour les usines de traitement des eaux usées municipales et industrielles, en soutenant la préparation d'offres et d'appels d'offres compétitifs. Le rôle combine la compréhension des processus, l'ingénierie des applications et les activités d'appel d'offres, avec un fort accent sur la sélection, la conception et l'intégration de technologies de traitement en fonction des exigences des clients, des contraintes du projet et des normes applicables. L'ingénieur agit comme une interface technique entre les ventes, l'ingénierie et les parties prenantes externes, contribuant à la définition de la solution dès le début de l'appel d'offres jusqu'au transfert du projet. RESPONSABILITÉS CLÉS : Appels d'offres et élaboration de propositions
• Analyser les appels d'offres, les documents d'appel d'offres et les spécifications techniques liés aux usines de traitement des eaux usées (STEP), tant civiles qu'industrielles.
• Développer des propositions techniques et commerciales complètes, en garantissant le respect des exigences du processus, des attentes des clients et des directives internes.
• Coordonner avec les départements internes (génie des procédés, génie mécanique, achats, finances, projets) pour recueillir les commentaires sur les offres.
• Effectuer l'estimation des coûts, les relevés de matériaux et la préparation des BOQ pour les solutions de traitement de l'eau et des eaux usées.
• Assurer la soumission ponctuelle et précise des offres et des réponses de clarification. Ingénierie d'application et support de processus
• Fournir un support technique et de processus avant-vente aux ventes et aux clients.
• Définir et recommander des solutions et des équipements de traitement pour :
• Traitement préliminaire et primaire
• Traitement secondaire (biologique)
• Étapes tertiaires et de polissage
• Traitement et manipulation des boues (le cas échéant)
• Dimensionner et configurer les unités et les packages de traitement (par exemple, tamis, dessablage, clarification, filtration, équipement de boues).
• Préparer les descriptions de processus, les fiches techniques, les mises en page et les clarifications techniques.
• Soutenir et participer à des réunions techniques, des ateliers et des présentations avec des clients, des consultants, des entrepreneurs EPC et des autorités. Interface client, consultant et fournisseur
• Assurer la liaison avec les clients, les consultants, les partenaires technologiques et les entrepreneurs EPC pour clarifier les processus et les aspects techniques pendant la phase d'appel d'offres.
• Interfacer avec les fournisseurs et les fabricants pour obtenir des devis, des données techniques et des informations de livraison.
• Aligner les solutions techniques avec les normes et spécifications internationales (par exemple EN, ISO, normes locales, exigences spécifiques au projet). Assistance post-offre et transfert de projet
• Effectuer le suivi des offres soumises et soutenir les clarifications techniques et les négociations post-offre.
• Contribuer à l'examen des contrats d'un point de vue technique et de l'étendue de la fourniture.
• Assurer un transfert structuré des projets attribués à l'équipe d'exécution, y compris toute la documentation technique, commerciale et de processus. Organisationnel et partage des connaissances
• Soutenir et encadrer les ingénieurs juniors d'application ou d'appel d'offres.
• Contribuer à la standardisation des solutions techniques, des outils et des modèles.
• Partager le savoir-faire sur les technologies et les applications de traitement des eaux usées au sein de l'organisation. EXIGENCES Qualifications et expérience
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie environnemental, chimique, mécanique ou civil (avec une exposition évidente au traitement de l'eau et des eaux usées).
• 4 à 7 ans d'expérience en ingénierie d'applications, appels d'offres ou ventes techniques dans le secteur du traitement de l'eau et des eaux usées.
• Expérience avérée des procédés de traitement des eaux usées municipales et/ou industrielles.
• Solide compréhension des technologies de traitement, de l'aménagement des usines et des interfaces de processus.
• Une expérience dans les appels d'offres pour des projets EPC ou du secteur public est un atout majeur. Compétences techniques et professionnelles
• Capacité à traduire les processus r

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Facility Manager is responsible for the overall management and maintenance of the operational facilities within Sulzer La Porte and associated satellite locations. You will have 2 direct reports and a team of 30 employees. Responsibilities
Facility Operations & Preventive Maintenance
Construction & Contractor Management
Inventory, Storage, & Space Optimization
Office & Administrative Facility Management
Leadership & Strategic Planning

• Ensure the facility operates safely, efficiently, and in full support of the Operational Business.

• Develop and implement a robust preventive maintenance program to minimize unplanned downtime, extend the life of critical assets, and improve operational reliability.

• Work with the Maintenance Supervisor to ensure that all machine tools, cranes, HVAC units, air compressors, and auxiliary systems are proactively maintained, reducing costly disruptions to production.

• Oversee warehousing, inventory, and customer storage. Ensuring parts, tools, and materials are strategically stored to minimize retrieval time, reduce handling inefficiencies, and improve workplace organization.

• Work closely with the inventory management team to refine storage solutions, streamline material movement, and optimize space utilization to maximize facility throughput.

• Coordinate all contractors performing work on-site, including those involved in construction, maintenance, and specialized system repairs. Including selecting vendors, negotiating contracts, ensuring work is completed on schedule and within budget, and enforcing all safety and compliance standards.

• Act as the primary point of contact for external service providers, ensuring that all projects align with the facility’s operational goals.

• Integrate preventive maintenance, inventory organization, space utilization, and contractor coordination, the Facility Manager ensures that the facility remains a high-performance environment capable of meeting the demands of a fast-paced, precision-driven industry.

Requirements

• Education & Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Operations, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

• 7+ years of experience in facility management, industrial operations, or maintenance leadership, preferably in a high-tech manufacturing or heavy industrial environment.

• Proven experience managing maintenance teams, construction projects, inventory operations, and contractor coordination in a complex industrial setting.

• Strong background in preventive and predictive maintenance programs for industrial equipment and building infrastructure.

• Experience with inventory management, space optimization, and logistics in a facility with work-in-progress materials.

• Demonstrated success in managing large-scale facility projects, including expansions, renovations, and utility upgrades.

• Experience overseeing waste management, environmental compliance, and sustainability initiatives.

• Technical Skills & Knowledge:
• Solid understanding of mechanical, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and structural systems in an industrial facility.

• Familiarity with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) and ERP systems for tracking maintenance and inventory.

• Knowledge of OSHA, EPA, NFPA, and other relevant safety and environmental regulations.

• Strong understanding of contractor management, permitting, and construction oversight.

• Ability to analyze facility operations and implement process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma)

• Leadership & Soft Skills:
• Strong leadership and team management skills, with experience overseeing multi-disciplinary teams.

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making

• Lavorare con il Supervisore di Manutenzione per garantire che tutti gli utensili, le gru, le unità HVAC, i compressori d'aria e i sistemi ausiliari siano proattivamente mantenuti, riducendo i disagi costosi alla produzione.
• Superare lo stoccaggio, l'inventario e l'archiviazione del cliente. Garantire parti, strumenti e materiali sono memorizzati strategicamente per ridurre al minimo i tempi di recupero, ridurre le inefficienze di gestione e migliorare l'organizzazione del posto di lavoro.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di gestione dell'inventario per affinare le soluzioni di storage, semplificare il movimento dei materiali e ottimizzare l'utilizzo dello spazio per massimizzare il throughput della struttura.

• Agire come punto di contatto principale per i fornitori di servizi esterni, assicurando che tutti i progetti si allineino agli obiettivi operativi della struttura.
• Integrare la manutenzione preventiva, l'organizzazione dell'inventario, l'utilizzo dello spazio e il coordinamento degli appaltatori, Facility Manager assicura che la struttura rimanga un ambiente ad alte prestazioni in grado di soddisfare le esigenze di un'industria veloce e di precisione. Requisiti
• Istruzione e esperienza
• Laurea in Gestione delle strutture, Ingegneria, Business Administration, Operazioni industriali, o un campo relativo (o equivalente esperienza di lavoro).
• 7+ anni di esperienza nella gestione delle strutture, nelle operazioni industriali o nella leadership di manutenzione, preferibilmente in un ambiente industriale ad alta tecnologia o in un ambiente industriale pesante.
• Prove esperienze di gestione team di manutenzione, progetti di costruzione, operazioni di inventario e coordinamento degli appaltatori in un ambiente industriale complesso.
• Forte background in programmi di manutenzione preventiva e predittiva per attrezzature industriali e infrastrutture di costruzione.
• Esperienza con la gestione dell'inventario, l'ottimizzazione dello spazio e la logistica in una struttura con materiali in corso di lavorazione.
• Successo dimostrato nella gestione di progetti di impianti su larga scala, tra cui espansioni, ristrutturazioni e aggiornamenti di utilità.
• Esperienza che supervisiona la gestione dei rifiuti, la conformità ambientale e le iniziative di sostenibilità.
• Competenze tecniche e conoscenza:
• Solida comprensione dei sistemi meccanici, elettrici, HVAC, idraulici e strutturali in un impianto industriale.
• Familiarità con CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) e sistemi ERP per il monitoraggio della manutenzione e dell'inventario.
• Conoscenza di OSHA, EPA, NFPA e altre normative in materia di sicurezza e ambiente.
• Forte comprensione della gestione degli appaltatori, permettendo e la supervisione della costruzione.
• Capacità di analizzare le operazioni delle strutture e implementare metodologie di miglioramento dei processi (ad esempio, Lean, Six Sigma)
• Leadership & Soft Skills:
• Forte capacità di leadership e gestione del team, con esperienza nel supervisione di team multidisciplinari.
• Ottima risoluzione dei problemi e decisione
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Facility Manager is responsible for the overall management and maintenance of the operational facilities within Sulzer La Porte and associated satellite locations. You will have 2 direct reports and a team of 30 employees. Responsibilities Facility Operations & Preventive Maintenance Construction & Contractor Management Inventory, Storage, & Space Optimization Office & Administrative Facility Management Leadership & Strategic Planning
• Ensure the facility operates safely, efficiently, and in full support of the Operational Business.
• Develop and implement a robust preventive maintenance program to minimize unplanned downtime, extend the life of critical assets, and improve operational reliability.
• Work with the Maintenance Supervisor to ensure that all machine tools, cranes, HVAC units, air compressors, and auxiliary systems are proactively maintained, reducing costly disruptions to production.
• Oversee warehousing, inventory, and customer storage. Ensuring parts, tools, and materials are strategically stored to minimize retrieval time, reduce handling inefficiencies, and improve workplace organization.
• Work closely with the inventory management team to refine storage solutions, streamline material movement, and optimize space utilization to maximize facility throughput.
• Coordinate all contractors performing work on-site, including those involved in construction, maintenance, and specialized system repairs. Including selecting vendors, negotiating contracts, ensuring work is completed on schedule and within budget, and enforcing all safety and compliance standards.
• Act as the primary point of contact for external service providers, ensuring that all projects align with the facility’s operational goals.
• Integrate preventive maintenance, inventory organization, space utilization, and contractor coordination, the Facility Manager ensures that the facility remains a high-performance environment capable of meeting the demands of a fast-paced, precision-driven industry. Requirements
• Education & Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Operations, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
• 7+ years of experience in facility management, industrial operations, or maintenance leadership, preferably in a high-tech manufacturing or heavy industrial environment.
• Proven experience managing maintenance teams, construction projects, inventory operations, and contractor coordination in a complex industrial setting.
• Strong background in preventive and predictive maintenance programs for industrial equipment and building infrastructure.
• Experience with inventory management, space optimization, and logistics in a facility with work-in-progress materials.
• Demonstrated success in managing large-scale facility projects, including expansions, renovations, and utility upgrades.
• Experience overseeing waste management, environmental compliance, and sustainability initiatives.
• Technical Skills & Knowledge:
• Solid understanding of mechanical, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and structural systems in an industrial facility.
• Familiarity with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) and ERP systems for tracking maintenance and inventory.
• Knowledge of OSHA, EPA, NFPA, and other relevant safety and environmental regulations.
• Strong understanding of contractor management, permitting, and construction oversight.
• Ability to analyze facility operations and implement process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma)
• Leadership & Soft Skills:
• Strong leadership and team management skills, with experience overseeing multi-disciplinary teams.
• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making

jobs.title: Welder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Welds, fabricates and reconditions components and parts to customers, OEM and industry standards using basic oxy-acetylene brazing techniques, shielded metal arc, gas metal arc, gas tungsten arc, submerged arc and other resistance welding operations. Cut materials and components require specification using oxy-acetylene, air arc and plasma equipment. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping, fitting and welding. Job Responsibilities:

• Sets up and operates welding and cutting equipment under limited supervision.

• Works within appropriate weld procedure guidelines to meet customer/contract specifications and apply knowledge of metals and alloys being welded or cut.

• Performs any other work necessary to finish and fit parts to required customer specifications including some pipe fitting/welding.

• Plans sequence of own work operations and methods of set-up based upon weld procedures being utilized and work order requirements.

• Maintains a safe, neat and orderly workstation.

• Maintains welding equipment as required to keep machines in good operating condition and maintains welding supplies and consumables in appropriate storage environment per specifications.

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required.

• Provides information to allow a smooth transition for other coworkers to follow through with in process work during or prior to a shift change as required

• Assists other team members as directed, including training and assisting less experienced coworkers.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

• Works overtime as requested.

Qualifications:

• Minimum of two years’ experience in cutting, welding and fabrication of various metal and alloy components

• Ability to learn and pass various weld certification test (s),

• Ability to read and interpret drawings and blueprints, apply knowledge of weld rods, weld wire, weld equipment settings and basic math skills.

• Possess basic hand tools, basic precision measuring tools and proper safety shoes and attire as specified by a minimum tool requirements list specific to the facility requirements.

• Able to carry out other tasks as diercted by supervisor (In absence of welding assignments).

• High School Diploma

• Must be able to complete pre-employment weld testing for 6G weld certification.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Riguardo al ruolo Saldature, fabbrica e ricondiziona componenti e parti ai clienti, standard OEM e industria utilizzando tecniche di brasatura ossiacetilene di base, arco metallico schermato, arco di gas metallico, arco di tungsteno gas, arco sommerso e altre operazioni di saldatura di resistenza. I materiali di taglio e i componenti richiedono specifiche utilizzando apparecchiature per l'ossiacetilene, l'arco dell'aria e il plasma. Interpreti disegni meccanici, progetti, schizzi ed esegue taglio di metallo di precisione, rettifica, sagomatura, montaggio e saldatura. Responsabilità del lavoro:
• Imposta e gestisce apparecchiature di saldatura e taglio sotto supervisione limitata.
• Opere all'interno di appropriate linee guida procedura di saldatura per soddisfare le specifiche del cliente / contratto e applicare la conoscenza di metalli e leghe saldati o tagliati.
• Esegue qualsiasi altro lavoro necessario per completare e adattare le parti alle specifiche richieste del cliente, tra cui alcuni raccordi / saldature del tubo.
• Pianifica la sequenza delle proprie operazioni di lavoro e dei metodi di configurazione in base alle procedure di saldatura utilizzate e ai requisiti di ordine di lavoro.
• Mantiene una postazione di lavoro sicura, pulita e ordinata.
• Mantiene le apparecchiature di saldatura come richiesto per mantenere le macchine in buone condizioni operative e mantiene forniture di saldatura e materiali di consumo in un ambiente di stoccaggio appropriato per specifiche.
• Assiste nello smontaggio, ispezione e riassemblaggio delle attrezzature della pompa quando necessario.
• Fornisce informazioni per consentire una transizione regolare per gli altri colleghi di seguire con il lavoro di processo durante o prima di un cambiamento a turni come richiesto
• Assiste altri membri del team come indicato, tra cui formazione e assistere i colleghi meno esperti.
• Supporta, collabora e partecipa allo sforzo aziendale di Quality Management.
• Esegui altre funzioni assegnate.
• Funziona lo straordinario come richiesto. Qualifiche:
• Minimo di due anni di esperienza nel taglio, saldatura e fabbricazione di vari componenti metallici e leghe
• Capacità di imparare e superare vari test di certificazione di saldatura (s),
• Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni e progetti, applicare la conoscenza di barre di saldatura, filo di saldatura, installazioni di saldatura e competenze di base matematica.
• Strumenti manuali di base, strumenti di misura di precisione di base e scarpe di sicurezza adeguate e abbigliamento come specificato da una lista di requisiti minimi degli strumenti specifici per i requisiti della struttura.
• In grado di svolgere altri compiti come dierti dal supervisore (in assenza di assegnazioni di saldatura).
• Diploma di scuola superiore
• Deve essere in grado di completare il test di saldatura pre-occupazione per la certificazione di saldatura 6G. Che cosa offriamo
• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni di vacanza a pagamento aziendale
• 401k piano con una partita del 6%
• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, breve e disabilità a lungo termine
• Conto di risparmio di salute corrispondente
• Programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Payroll Specialist is responsible for supporting accurate and compliant payroll operations using ADP for payroll processing, covering approximately 930 employees with administrative support for a broader population of up to 1,300 employees.

This role plays a key part in certified payroll reporting under the Davis-Bacon Act and provides administrative and backup support for union payroll activities.

The position focuses on payroll accuracy, compliance, reporting, and cross-functional coordination, rather than direct ownership of union payroll processing.
Payroll Processing & Administration (ADP)

• Process bi-weekly and off-cycle payrolls in ADP, ensuring accurate calculation of earnings, taxes, deductions, and garnishments.

• Review and validate payroll inputs originating from Workday (HRIS), including new hires, job changes, compensation updates, and terminations.

• Reconcile payroll data between Workday and ADP to ensure data integrity and alignment across systems.

• Perform payroll audits, balancing (gross-to-net), and variance analysis prior to payroll submission.

• Process adjustments, retroactive pay, and final pay calculations in compliance with company policy and applicable laws.

• Provide responsive, professional support for employee and manager payroll inquiries.

Certified Payroll Reporting (Davis-Bacon Act)

• Prepare and submit certified payroll reports (e.g., WH-347) for projects subject to Davis-Bacon and prevailing wage requirements.

• Collect and validate required data, including: Labor classifications
Prevailing wage rates and fringe allocations
Hours worked by project and location

• Ensure all reporting is accurate, complete, and submitted in accordance with contract and regulatory deadlines.

• Partner with Project Managers, Finance, and HR to ensure correct labor coding and project setup.

• Maintain documentation and support internal and external audits related to certified payroll compliance.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies in payroll data impacting certified payroll reporting (note: this role does not process the payroll itself for certified projects).

Union Payroll Support (Administrative & Backup)

• Serve as backup support to the primary union payroll processor.

• Assist with union reporting and administrative tasks, including: Union dues reconciliation
Benefit and pension contribution reporting
Remittance preparation and review

• Support validation of union-related payroll data and escalate discrepancies as needed.

• Stay informed of union contract changes and assist in ensuring updates are reflected in payroll processes and reporting.

Compliance, Controls & Process Improvement

• Ensure payroll operations comply with federal, state, and local wage and hour regulations.

• Maintain accurate payroll records and audit trails for compliance and internal controls.

• Support payroll-related audits, including certified payroll and union reporting reviews.

Required Qualifications

• CPP Certified

• 5+ years of payroll experience

• Experience processing multi-jurisdiction payroll

• Experience using ADP payroll systems

• Knowledge of certified payroll reporting, specifically Davis-Bacon Act requirements.

• Basic understanding of union payroll structures and reporting requirements.

• Strong Excel skills (data analysis, reconciliation, lookups).

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

À propos du rôle Le spécialiste de la paye est chargé d'appuyer des opérations de paye exactes et conformes à l'aide de la PDA pour le traitement de la paye, couvrant environ 930 employés avec un soutien administratif pour une population plus vaste de 1 300 employés. Ce rôle joue un rôle clé dans l'établissement de rapports de paie certifiés en vertu de la Loi Davis-Bacon et fournit un soutien administratif et de secours pour les activités de paye des syndicats. Le poste est axé sur l'exactitude des états de paie, la conformité, les rapports et la coordination interfonctionnelle, plutôt que sur la propriété directe du traitement des états de paie des syndicats. Traitement et administration des états de paie (ADP)
• Traiter les états de paie bihebdomadaires et hors cycle dans ADP, en assurant le calcul exact des gains, impôts, déductions et saisies.

• Fournir un soutien professionnel adapté aux demandes de renseignements sur la paie des employés et des gestionnaires. Rapports de paie certifiés (Loi Davis-Bacon)

• Recueillir et valider les données requises, y compris : Classifications du travail Taux de rémunération préexistants et allocations marginales Heures travaillées par projet et lieu de travail

• Tenir à jour la documentation et appuyer les audits internes et externes liés à la conformité certifiée des états de paie.
• Recenser et résoudre les écarts dans les données sur les états de paie qui influent sur les rapports de paie certifiés (note : ce rôle ne traite pas les états de paie eux-mêmes pour les projets certifiés). Soutien de la paie syndicale (administration et sauvegarde)

• Restez informé des changements apportés aux contrats syndicaux et aidez à faire en sorte que les mises à jour soient prises en compte dans les processus de paye et les rapports. Conformité, contrôles et amélioration des processus

• Tenir des états de paie exacts et des pistes de vérification pour la conformité et les contrôles internes.
• Appuyer les audits liés aux états de paie, y compris les examens certifiés des états de paie et des rapports des syndicats. Qualifications requises

• Expérience de l'utilisation des systèmes de paye ADP

jobs.title: Journey Level Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision.

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.

• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.

• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor. Perform other duties as necessary.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required

• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.

• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures

• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

• Basic math skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Product Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a top employer and one of the world's leading pump manufacturers. Sulzer provides a wide range of products for pumping solutions for water, oil and gas, power, and chemicals industries. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a Product Development Engineer for the Technology Center in Thimister/Belgium.

This is a fantastic opportunity for you to focus on the development and standardization of products with our teams globally. As the Product Development Engineer, you will be given the opportunity to work on innovative projects ranging from design activities to product enhancement activities.

If you are talented Mechanical Engineer who is enthusiastic, self-motivated and have a passion to produce high quality engineering, we would love to hear from you! We offer you interesting and challenging tasks in a global, multi-cultural environment. This is your chance to join a leading organization, contributing to a cutting-edge initiative, and make a real impact on the future success of Sulzer.

Location: We are based in Thimister-Clermont, Belgium.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Responsible for the Product Development project activities and for achieving the project objectives.

• Design activities such as the creation of design studies, master assemblies and detailed drawings, including related design calculations.

• Coordinate detailed design drawing activities globally.

• Standardize key design features for the product range.

• Create and maintain product documentation such as design catalogues, hydraulic performance curves, product manuals and tools.

• Utilize current technologies, develop tools and methods to control designs.

• Effective communication with manufacturing entities and Product Management global organization to ensure a collaborative approach.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering with 4+ years’ industry experience

• Fluency in English and French

• Strong collaboration skills within a global, multicultural environment

• Proficiency in 2D and 3D CAD tools (e.g. NX, SolidWorks)

• A customer-focused mindset with the ability to translate technical needs into solutions

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail

What we offer you

• Continuous development opportunities, with full access to the Sulzer Learning Platform to support your personal and professional growth

• 36 days of annual leave

• A comprehensive pension and group insurance scheme designed to support your long-term security

• Private health insurance for you and your family

• Meal vouchers daily

• Global career development opportunities, with exposure to international projects and mobility across the Sulzer network

• The chance to work in an innovative, agile, and vibrant culture where your ideas and impact truly matter

Have a question about the role? Reach out to the Hiring Manager – Claude Mockels or the recruiting team – Stéphanie Piron. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Sulzer è un datore di lavoro superiore e uno dei principali produttori di pompe al mondo. Sulzer offre una vasta gamma di prodotti per la pompaggio di soluzioni per le industrie di acqua, petrolio e gas, energia e prodotti chimici. A causa della crescita continua, stiamo cercando un ingegnere di sviluppo del prodotto per il Centro tecnologico a Thimister/Belgio. Questa è una fantastica opportunità per voi di concentrarsi sullo sviluppo e la standardizzazione dei prodotti con i nostri team a livello globale. In qualità di Product Development Engineer, ti sarà data l'opportunità di lavorare su progetti innovativi che vanno dalle attività di progettazione alle attività di valorizzazione del prodotto. Se siete talentuosi Ingegnere meccanico che è entusiasta, auto-motivato e hanno una passione per la produzione di ingegneria di alta qualità, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi! Vi offriamo compiti interessanti e impegnativi in un ambiente globale e multiculturale. Questa è la tua occasione per unire un'organizzazione leader, contribuendo a un'iniziativa all'avanguardia, e fare un impatto reale sul futuro successo di Sulzer. Posizione: Abbiamo sede a Thimister-Clermont, Belgio. I vostri compiti e le vostre responsabilità principali:
• Responsabile per le attività del progetto di sviluppo del prodotto e per raggiungere gli obiettivi del progetto.
• Attività di progettazione come la creazione di studi di progettazione, assemblaggi master e disegni dettagliati, compresi i relativi calcoli di progettazione.
• Coordinate attività di disegno di design dettagliate a livello globale.
• Standardizzare le caratteristiche di design chiave per la gamma di prodotti.
• Creare e mantenere la documentazione del prodotto come cataloghi di progettazione, curve di prestazione idrauliche, manuali di prodotto e strumenti.
• Utilizzare le tecnologie attuali, sviluppare strumenti e metodi per controllare i progetti.
• Una comunicazione efficace con gli enti di produzione e l'organizzazione globale di Product Management per garantire un approccio collaborativo. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Una laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica con 4+ anni di esperienza nel settore
• Fluenza in inglese e francese
• Forte capacità di collaborazione all'interno di un ambiente globale e multiculturale
• Proficienza negli strumenti CAD 2D e 3D (ad esempio NX, SolidWorks)
• Una mentalità orientata al cliente con la capacità di tradurre le esigenze tecniche in soluzioni
• Capacità di comunicazione e coinvolgimento degli stakeholder
• Alto livello di precisione e attenzione
• Opportunità di sviluppo continue, con accesso completo alla piattaforma di apprendimento Sulzer per sostenere la vostra crescita personale e professionale
• 36 giorni di congedo annuale
• Un sistema di assicurazione pensione completa e di gruppo progettato per supportare la vostra sicurezza a lungo termine
• Assicurazione sanitaria privata per voi e la vostra famiglia
• Buoni medici ogni giorno
