Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is a top employer and one of the world's leading pump manufacturers. Sulzer provides a wide range of products for pumping solutions for water, oil and gas, power, and chemicals industries. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a Product Development Engineer for the Technology Center in Thimister/Belgium. This is a fantastic opportunity for you to focus on the development and standardization of products with our teams globally. As the Product Development Engineer, you will be given the opportunity to work on innovative projects ranging from design activities to product enhancement activities. If you are talented Mechanical Engineer who is enthusiastic, self-motivated and have a passion to produce high quality engineering, we would love to hear from you! We offer you interesting and challenging tasks in a global, multi-cultural environment. This is your chance to join a leading organization, contributing to a cutting-edge initiative, and make a real impact on the future success of Sulzer. Location: We are based in Thimister-Clermont, Belgium. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Responsible for the Product Development project activities and for achieving the project objectives.
• Design activities such as the creation of design studies, master assemblies and detailed drawings, including related design calculations.
• Coordinate detailed design drawing activities globally.
• Standardize key design features for the product range.
• Create and maintain product documentation such as design catalogues, hydraulic performance curves, product manuals and tools.
• Utilize current technologies, develop tools and methods to control designs.
• Effective communication with manufacturing entities and Product Management global organization to ensure a collaborative approach. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A degree in Mechanical Engineering with 4+ years’ industry experience
• Fluency in English and French
• Strong collaboration skills within a global, multicultural environment
• Proficiency in 2D and 3D CAD tools (e.g. NX, SolidWorks)
• A customer-focused mindset with the ability to translate technical needs into solutions
• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
• High level of accuracy and attention to detail What we offer you
• Continuous development opportunities, with full access to the Sulzer Learning Platform to support your personal and professional growth
• 36 days of annual leave
• A comprehensive pension and group insurance scheme designed to support your long-term security
• Private health insurance for you and your family
• Meal vouchers daily
• Global career development opportunities, with exposure to international projects and mobility across the Sulzer network
• The chance to work in an innovative, agile, and vibrant culture where your ideas and impact truly matter Have a question about the role? We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. À propos du rôle de Sulzer est un employeur de premier plan et l'un des principaux fabricants de pompes au monde. Sulzer fournit une large gamme de produits pour les solutions de pompage pour les industries de l'eau, du pétrole et du gaz, de l'énergie et des produits chimiques. En raison de la croissance continue, nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de développement de produits pour le Centre de technologie à Thimister/Belgique. C'est une occasion fantastique pour vous de vous concentrer sur le développement et la normalisation des produits avec nos équipes à l'échelle mondiale. En tant qu'ingénieur en développement de produits, vous aurez la possibilité de travailler sur des projets innovateurs allant des activités de conception aux activités d'amélioration de produits. Si vous êtes talentueux Ingénieur Mécanique qui est enthousiaste, automotivé et a une passion pour produire une ingénierie de haute qualité, nous aimerions entendre de vous! Nous vous proposons des tâches intéressantes et stimulantes dans un environnement multiculturel mondial. C'est votre chance de rejoindre une organisation de premier plan, de contribuer à une initiative de pointe et d'avoir un impact réel sur le succès futur de Sulzer. Lieu: Nous sommes basés à Thimister-Clermont, Belgique. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:
• Responsable des activités du projet de développement de produits et de la réalisation des objectifs du projet.
• Des activités de conception telles que la création d'études de conception, d'assemblages principaux et de dessins détaillés, y compris des calculs de conception connexes.
• Coordonner les activités de conception détaillées à l'échelle mondiale.
• Normaliser les principales caractéristiques de conception de la gamme de produits.
• Créez et maintenez la documentation des produits tels que les catalogues de conception, les courbes de performance hydraulique, les manuels de produits et les outils.
• Utiliser les technologies actuelles, développer des outils et des méthodes pour contrôler les conceptions.

• d'une bonne connaissance de l'anglais et du français ;
• de solides compétences en collaboration au sein d'un environnement mondial et multiculturel ;
• d'une maîtrise des outils CAO 2D et 3D (p. ex. NX, SolidWorks) ;
• d'un état d'esprit axé sur le client, capable de traduire les besoins techniques en solutions ;
• d'excellentes compétences en communication et en engagement des parties prenantes ;
• d'un niveau élevé de précision et d'attention aux détails. Ce que nous vous offrons
• Possibilités de développement continu, avec un accès complet à la plate-forme d'apprentissage Sulzer pour soutenir votre croissance personnelle et professionnelle
• 36 jours de congé annuel
• Un régime global de retraite et d'assurance collective conçu pour soutenir votre sécurité à long terme
• Assurance santé privée pour vous et votre famille
• Chèque repas quotidien
• Possibilités de développement de carrière globale, avec une exposition à des projets internationaux et la mobilité à travers le réseau Sulzer
• La chance de travailler dans une culture innovatrice, agile et dynamique où vos idées et vos impacts sont vraiment importants Avez-vous une question sur le rôle? Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: R&D Intern
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Student or Intern is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. Purpose of the Job
​​We are seeking a motivated and meticulous laboratory intern to join our dynamic team. This internship will provide you with valuable hands-on experience in a laboratory setting and the opportunity to contribute to our ongoing research and development projects. ​ You will get to involve to operate state of the art equipments and technology to learn the real operating the equipment and/or pilot plant.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Assist in the setup and execution of bench-scale experiments for process development and feasibility studies prior to pilot testing

• Support sample preparation, equipment operation, and experimental execution
Perform laboratory analyses using analytical instruments such as GC, GC-MS, HPLC, ICP-MS, Karl Fischer titrator, UV-Vis, density meter, etc.

• Record, organize, and analyze experimental data to support process optimization and scale-up

• Maintain laboratory safety, cleanliness, and compliance with ESH requirements
Support documentation of experimental results and technical findings

What we offer you

6 month Internship - comes with leave and medical benefits.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Ingenieur Qualite Projets
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Votre mission principale sera de vous assurer du respect des exigences qualité & sûreté nucléaire tout au long de la réalisation de la commande client (de la prise de commandes jusqu’à la livraison).

Activités significatives :

Chiffrage de l’appel d’offre / commandes
- Participer au chiffrage des heures qualité dans l’établissement de l’offre client.
- Analyser les spécifications clients et leur impact sur le déroulement de l’affaire.
- Etablir les documents qualité requis au moment de l’appel d’offres.
- Réaliser une analyse de risque de non-qualité de l’appel d’offres.

Une fois l’affaire prise en commande, au moment du lancement en fabrication
- Vérification et prise en compte des spécifications qualité.
- Elaboration et préparation de toute la documentation qualité (QCP, DSI, PQP, liste AIP).
- Réalisation du programme de surveillance fournisseur.

Pendant le déroulement de l’affaire
- Mise en œuvre du programme de surveillance fournisseur.
- Gestion de la surveillance client (réalisation des convocations, participation aux inspections, …).
- Validation des documents qualité fournisseurs.
- Vérification des documents qualité interne.
- Suivre et valider le traitement des Non Conformités.
- Participation aux analyses des causes profondes et proposition d’action d’amélioration.

Après la livraison client
- Elaborer les documents de fin d’affaires (RFF, RFR, RFI, inclus DCI).
- Suivre les réclamations clients et garanties.

Compétences requises :

Compétences métier – technique

• Connaissances générales en ingénierie des matériaux (différents aciers, forge, fonderie)

• Connaissances de l’environnement industriel et métallurgie (mécanique de précision, petites et moyennes séries).

• Compétences en CND (Contrôle Non Destructif)

• Compétences en procédés de fabrication de la métallurgie.

• Connaissance de la métrologie (documentation en fonction des normes, notions de mesure) vérification des PV de métrologies

• IWE classique (soudure)

• Connaissance des techniques d’audit et d’inspection

• Anglais courant

Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire

• Maîtrise du code RCCM

• Connaissances de la norme ISO 19443 (relative à la sûreté nucléaire)

• Compétences en sûreté nucléaire (HN3)

• Connaissances des méthodes de détection de fraude et de contrefaçon

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Votre mission principale sera de vous assurer du respect des exigences qualité & sûreté nucléaire tout au long de la réalisation de la commande client (de la prise de commandes jusqu’à la livraison). Activités significatives : Chiffrage de l’appel d’offre / commandes - Participer au chiffrage des heures qualité dans l’établissement de l’offre client. - Analyser les spécifications clients et leur impact sur le déroulement de l’affaire. - Etablir les documents qualité requis au moment de l’appel d’offres. - Réaliser une analyse de risque de non-qualité de l’appel d’offres. Une fois l’affaire prise en commande, au moment du lancement en fabrication - Vérification et prise en compte des spécifications qualité. - Elaboration et préparation de toute la documentation qualité (QCP, DSI, PQP, liste AIP). - Réalisation du programme de surveillance fournisseur. Pendant le déroulement de l’affaire - Mise en œuvre du programme de surveillance fournisseur. - Gestion de la surveillance client (réalisation des convocations, participation aux inspections, …). - Validation des documents qualité fournisseurs. - Vérification des documents qualité interne. - Suivre et valider le traitement des Non Conformités. - Participation aux analyses des causes profondes et proposition d’action d’amélioration. Après la livraison client - Elaborer les documents de fin d’affaires (RFF, RFR, RFI, inclus DCI). - Suivre les réclamations clients et garanties. Compétences requises : Compétences métier – technique
• Connaissances générales en ingénierie des matériaux (différents aciers, forge, fonderie)
• Connaissances de l’environnement industriel et métallurgie (mécanique de précision, petites et moyennes séries).
• Compétences en CND (Contrôle Non Destructif)
• Compétences en procédés de fabrication de la métallurgie.
• Connaissance de la métrologie (documentation en fonction des normes, notions de mesure) vérification des PV de métrologies
• IWE classique (soudure)
• Connaissance des techniques d’audit et d’inspection
• Anglais courant Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire
• Maîtrise du code RCCM
• Connaissances de la norme ISO 19443 (relative à la sûreté nucléaire)
• Compétences en sûreté nucléaire (HN3)
• Connaissances des méthodes de détection de fraude et de contrefaçon What we offer you
• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe
• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER
• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe
• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)
• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT
• et bien d'autres... Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Lean Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lean Manager is responsible for supporting the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role applies practical engineering knowledge to improve efficiency, quality, and safety in production environments.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision.
• At factory level, use lean manufacturing principles to achieve operational business targets.

• Assist supervisor and managers with action plan to achieve company objectives.

• Support manufacturing improvements through tooling and equipment design and equipment specification development.

• Improve On Time Delivery and Lead Times though the implementation of continuous flow, layout optimization, pull-system and speed up flows by coaching and/or leading lean principles workshops.

• Contribute to Factory Improvement Plan.

• Review continuous improvement plans and cost-saving projections, challenging where necessary, and provide feedback that drives additional improvements.

• Support continuous failure analysis in cooperation with affected areas.

• Improve Root Cause Analysis knowledge and utilization within the organization.

• Prepare and submit performance reports as required.

• Support corporate initiatives as defined by the Management Team.

• All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of Personal Protective Equipment.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Specialist/Order Management
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Order Coordinator is responsible for coordinating order processing activities and supporting the team in non-routine situations. This role ensures smooth communication between departments and accurate order fulfillment.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Coordinate order entry and tracking processes.
Resolve order-related issues with internal teams.
Communicate with customers regarding order status.
Maintain accurate records and update systems.
Support reporting and process improvement initiatives.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
Typically requires advanced vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role.

Strong coordination and communication skills.
Experience in order processing or logistics.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP tools.
Attention to detail and ability to work independently.

This position requires the ability to perform essential job functions in an office environment, including prolonged periods of sitting, working at a computer, and communicating with others. Occasional standing, walking, and lifting of up to 10–20 pounds may be required. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment drug screening and, where applicable, ongoing testing in accordance with company policies and legal requirements. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Manager serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget .

Key Responsibilities:

• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.

• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.

• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.

• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.

• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.

• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.

• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.

• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions.

Skills & Qualifications
Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).

• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.

• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).

• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time

• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets.

Preferred Assets:

• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.

• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.

• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed).

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Laboratory Technician / Chemical Technician to join our Applications & Technologies team in Allschwil.

In this exciting role you will plan and execute customer trials as well as actively support on internal research and development (R&D) projects. You will conduct diverse practical lab work in the R&D field to improve sustainability in the chemical industry and develop future technologies.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Characterization analysis using key techniques, including: gas chromatography (GC) with headspace and liquid sampling coupled to MS, FID, and TCD detectors; high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV and refractive index (RI) detection; inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES); UV–Vis spectrophotometry; differential scanning calorimetry (DSC); optical microscopy; X‑ray powder diffraction (XRPD); Raman spectroscopy; as well as classical methods such as titration, water content determination, density, and viscosity measurements.

• Responsible for analytical support, ensuring the implementation and optimization of methods and operability of corresponding devices during trials (including instrument preparation, external calibration, sample preparation and routine measurements)

• Planning, execution, evaluation and reporting of customer trials (bench scale to pilot scale).

• Support in execution of internal and external trials for the development and optimization of Sulzer technologies;

• Work in close co-operation with internal company stakeholders;

• Ensure and respect appropriate ESH measures and "good laboratory practice" during daily business. Actively contribute to management of change and risk assessments. Respect safety regulations and quality procedures, report near misses, incidents and accidents. Consider LEAN aspects at work.

• Suggest and implement improvements in the analytical laboratory;

• Support and participate in the deployment of Technology & Innovation (T&I) Digitalization strategy.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Diploma lab/ chemical technician (apprenticeship, technical degree)

• 3-5 years of experience in a similar role

• Excellent English. German and French are an asset

• Good technical knowledge in analytical chemistry is essential

• Highly proficient with various instruments and techniques such as GC (MS, FID and TCD), HPLC (UV and RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS spectrophotometer, titration and measurement of physical properties such as density and viscosity

• Awareness for safe handling of chemicals, potentially hazardous materials and equipment

• Great team player, strong communication skills, strong organization ability, very independent, flexible, trustworthy, customer oriented and adaptable.

What we offer you

• Attractive compensation and vacation plan

• Excellent social benefits

• Global development opportunities

• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture

• Free parking space and accessibility with public transportation

• Employee Assistance Program

• Long service awards

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Laboratory Technician / Chemical Technician to join our Applications & Technologies team in Allschwil. In this exciting role you will plan and execute customer trials as well as actively support on internal research and development (R&D) projects. You will conduct diverse practical lab work in the R&D field to improve sustainability in the chemical industry and develop future technologies. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Characterization analysis using key techniques, including: gas chromatography (GC) with headspace and liquid sampling coupled to MS, FID, and TCD detectors; high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV and refractive index (RI) detection; inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES); UV–Vis spectrophotometry; differential scanning calorimetry (DSC); optical microscopy; X‑ray powder diffraction (XRPD); Raman spectroscopy; as well as classical methods such as titration, water content determination, density, and viscosity measurements.
• Responsible for analytical support, ensuring the implementation and optimization of methods and operability of corresponding devices during trials (including instrument preparation, external calibration, sample preparation and routine measurements)
• Planning, execution, evaluation and reporting of customer trials (bench scale to pilot scale).
• Support in execution of internal and external trials for the development and optimization of Sulzer technologies;
• Work in close co-operation with internal company stakeholders;
• Ensure and respect appropriate ESH measures and "good laboratory practice" during daily business. Actively contribute to management of change and risk assessments. Respect safety regulations and quality procedures, report near misses, incidents and accidents. Consider LEAN aspects at work.
• Suggest and implement improvements in the analytical laboratory;
• Support and participate in the deployment of Technology & Innovation (T&I) Digitalization strategy. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Diploma lab/ chemical technician (apprenticeship, technical degree)
• 3-5 years of experience in a similar role
• Excellent English. German and French are an asset
• Good technical knowledge in analytical chemistry is essential
• Highly proficient with various instruments and techniques such as GC (MS, FID and TCD), HPLC (UV and RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS spectrophotometer, titration and measurement of physical properties such as density and viscosity
• Awareness for safe handling of chemicals, potentially hazardous materials and equipment
• Great team player, strong communication skills, strong organization ability, very independent, flexible, trustworthy, customer oriented and adaptable. What we offer you
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
• Excellent social benefits
• Global development opportunities
• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture
• Free parking space and accessibility with public transportation
• Employee Assistance Program
• Long service awards Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Purpose of the job
Supports CAE activities for ORE, PD and CT projects globally. Compilation of mechanical analysis documentation provided to clients, proving the mechanical, rotordynamic and structural integrity of products, ensuring conformity to established industry, company standards and customer specifications

Main tasks and responsibilities

• Rotordynamic analysis (Lateral and Torsional) of centrifugal pumps.

• Pump design calculations as per international standards.

• Structural and Dynamic analysis of Baseplate and Vertical Pump using ANSYS Workbench

• Preparation & submission of calculation reports and coordinating for customer approvals.

• Provide technical assistance to project team to solve possible discrepancies & review and issue and follow-up the comments on reports, specifications, etc.

• Making design recommendations to provide acceptable rotordynamic level, behavior of pump and help to resolve difficult or unusual product design engineering problems.

• Capable of performing routine mechanical engineering calculations and analysis.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required:
• Bachelor’s or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Relevant experience in Rotating machine industry practices & standards.

• Experience in finite element analysis techniques and calculations

• Experience of rotor dynamics, FEA using Ansys

• Solid understanding of structural mechanics fundamentals and basic vibration

• Knowledge of in 2D/3D CAD & PLM software

• Knowledge of Microsoft Excel, word and power point

• Knowledge of Industry Code & Standards such ASME, EN, API, etc

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

 Communication skills
 Relationship management skills
 Customer service skills
 Time management skills
 Ability to act independently
 Flexibility and ability to adapt to change
 Attention to detail
 Meet quality objectives set and KPIs

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. On time Submission of tenders
• Techno commercially optimum and competitive offers
• On time submission and closure of technical clarifications, Technical bid clarification meeting as required
• Clear handover of the project to project team after order, attending ORM
• Close project open points if any and attend customer KOM if required
• Analyze RFQs, tenders, and bid documents for centrifugal pumps (API 610, ISO, ANSI, API 610 / ISO 5199 / ISO 2858 / client specs)
• horizontal/vertical, multistage, etc.)
• Basic Knowledge for Bought out items like, Mechanical Seal & Seal Plan, Motors, Lube Oil System
• Prepare commercial offers , BOQ-based pricing, and option sheets.
• Co-ordinate with Procurement for bought‑out items, factory for delivery timelines & Sales for commercial terms and margins.
• Provide pre‑bid clarifications and participate in technical discussions
• Support sales teams during during Negotiations & Pre- Bid technical Justifications
• Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting
• Review quote received and challenge as necessary internal as well as external stakeholders to ensure a competitive proposal is submitted meeting Sales / market expectation

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Design Engineer is responsible for the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of plant buildings and machinery. This includes establishing standards for pollution control, testing, and maintenance, and recommending new equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.
• Provide technical support to the Sales and Tendering teams throughout the bidding process.

• Review pump selections prepared by the Tendering team to ensure technical compliance and optimization.

• Review and interpret client specifications, particularly for critical or special requirements.

• Coordinate with the Design Responsible (DR) team to obtain additional technical inputs and solutions.

• Interact directly with customers to understand specific application needs and incorporate them into the design layout.

• Liaise with suppliers to resolve technical queries and obtain necessary clarifications.

• Coordinate with other Sulzer legal entities (SPUK, SPDE, SPSZH, SPUSA) to obtain technical support and share expertise.

• Provide technical assistance to the Costing department during the bidding stage.

• Prepare preliminary Pump General Arrangement (GA) drawings for customer submission.

• Estimate “not‑to‑exceed” dimensions based on pump selection and buyout drawings.

• Coordinate with Order Engineering teams (Hydraulics, Bare Pump, Packaging, Instrumentation, Electrical, etc.) to address special or non‑standard requirements.

• Support and collaborate with Operations, Purchase, Sales, and Tendering teams during technical evaluations.

• Proactively support company initiatives that promote safe working practices, environmental protection, and continuous improvement.

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Procurement Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer GT Aero (formerly Alba Power) is a global leader in gas turbine maintenance, repair and overhaul, supporting critical energy infrastructure worldwide. Now part of Sulzer’s renowned rotating equipment services business, we combine decades of engineering expertise with a strong focus on supply chain excellence, partnering with suppliers to deliver quality, cost efficiency and reliability at scale.

We are currently looking for a Procurement Administrator to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to support a high-performing procurement function, managing supplier data, processing purchase orders and helping ensure smooth, efficient supply chain operations. Ideal for someone organised, detail-focused and keen to build a career in procurement within a global engineering business. Job Responsibilities

• Process purchase requisitions and convert them into purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner.

• Maintain and update supplier information, including contact details, pricing agreements, and performance records.

• Assist in the preparation of Request for Quotations (RFQs) and Request for Proposals (RFPs), circulating them to potential suppliers.

• Track and expedite orders, ensuring on-time delivery and resolving any supply chain issues or delays.

• Generate procurement reports, including spend analysis, supplier performance, and inventory levels.

• Support the negotiation of favorable terms and conditions with suppliers.

Job Qualifications

• Proven experience in an administrative or support role, preferably within a procurement or supply chain department.

• Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and experience with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is highly desirable.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to task completion.

• Knowledge of procurement principles and practices is a plus.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Serviceleder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service i Sulzer er et spennende og interessant fagfelt, og har ofte et høyt tempo. Det å bidra til at folk har rent vann og fungerende infrastruktur for vann- og avløp er et av de viktigste samfunnsoppdragene som finnes! Vi trives best med flere baller i luften, i et arbeidsmiljø hvor kreativitet og rasjonalitet går hånd i hånd. Vi liker kort avstand mellom verksted og ledelse, hvor ideer blir hørt og hvor muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling blir gitt.
Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss!

Stillingen inneholder blant annet:

• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.

• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.

• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.

• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.

• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.

• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.

• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang.

Hovedoppgaver
Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:

• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.

• Personalansvar for teknikerne

• Kundekontakt og befaringer

• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet

• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt

• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner.

Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge

Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning

• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse

• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende

• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr

• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.

• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt

• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk

• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)

• Gode kunnskaper innen IT

Personlige styrker

• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer

• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team

• Kundeorientert

• Teknisk nysgjerrighet

What we offer you

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?

jobs.title: Internal Quality Auditor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The entry-level Internal Quality Auditor is responsible for the execution of day-to-day quality assurance activities. This includes setting operational objectives, ensuring adherence to quality standards, and resolving routine quality issues. Key Responsibilities:

• Implement and maintain QESH management systems in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.

• Ability and willingness to travel to Service Centers across the US 5-7 times per year.

• Conduct internal audits, inspections, and risk assessments across production areas.

• Lead incident investigations, identify root causes, and track corrective actions.

• Provide training and guidance to employees on QESH policies and safe work practices.

• Monitor and report on QESH KPIs, including non-conformities, near misses, and environmental metrics.

• Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives and lean manufacturing efforts

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate QESH into daily operations.

• Maintain documentation and prepare for external audits and customer inspections.

• Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory quality standards.

• Investigate and resolve routine quality issues.

• Support audits and continuous improvement initiatives

Requirements:

• Intermediate knowledge of MS Word MS Excel required

• Basic knowledge or MS SharePoint and MS PowerPoint preferred

• 1+ years of experience in Internal Quality Audits preferred but not required

• Knowledge of quality assurance practices and tools.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

• Effective communication and documentation abilities.

• Familiarity with manufacturing environments.

• Experience in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 environments preferred

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer Chemtech, a global leader in mass transfer, static mixing, and polymer solutions for the chemicals, petrochemicals, refining, and LNG industries. We drive innovation in separation and purification technologies, including sustainable solutions for biopolymers and recycling.

We’re seeking a Regional Sales Manager – South Region with an entrepreneurial mindset to grow our Mass Transfer Components business in Canada. You’ll lead sales efforts, build strong client relationships, and deliver tailored solutions that enhance customer success. This role offers the opportunity to shape a dynamic territory. Join us and be part of a company shaping the future of process industries with world-class technology and a commitment to innovation and environmental responsibility.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Drive Growth : Own and grow order intake and profitability across the assigned region by executing strategic sales initiatives and uncovering new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, and market analysis.

• Execute a World-Class Sales Process : Manage the entire sales cycle — from lead generation to closing — using CRM tools to maintain accurate forecasts, document customer visits, and track opportunities through all sales stages.

• Engage Clients with Technical Expertise : Deliver customized technical presentations and collaborate with internal Application Engineering and Field Services teams to develop tailored solutions across sectors including Refinery, Upstream, Chemical, and Carbon Capture.

• Build Strategic Relationships : Develop and maintain long-term partnerships with key clients and stakeholders, ensuring continued business growth and customer satisfaction.

• Navigate Commercial Complexities : Assess and mitigate risks related to contracts, pricing, and terms by interfacing with Legal, Accounting, and other internal departments to ensure commercially sound deals.

• Stay Ahead of the Curve : Monitor competitor activity and industry trends, attend trade shows and conferences, and regularly report on territory performance to support agile sales strategies.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Hunter Mentality : You are a strategic go-getter who knows how to identify and engage the ideal customer. You bring a creative approach to building relationships, with real-world examples of how you've done it before.

• Growth-Driven Mindset : You excel at mapping markets, identifying white space, and developing actionable strategies to break into new customer segments. You’re as comfortable developing marketing initiatives as you are closing deals.

• Tenacity and Drive : You’re motivated by targets and not afraid to roll up your sleeves. You proactively chase new opportunities while seamlessly collaborating with Application and Technical teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.

• Strong Commercial Acumen : With 5+ years in a front-line sales role, you’ve mastered the art of the sale — from lead generation to closing. You know contracts, negotiate with confidence, and keep your CRM forecasts sharp and accurate.

• Customer Excellence : You’re authentic, approachable, and easy to work with — someone customers enjoy talking to and trust. Your commitment to service creates long-term partnerships that fuel sustained growth.

• Industry-Proven Experience : You bring at least five years of success selling industrial equipment or services in oil & gas or related sectors, with a solid track record selling.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Unisciti a Sulzer Chemtech, leader globale nel trasferimento di massa, nella miscelazione statica e nelle soluzioni polimeriche per le industrie chimiche, petrolchimiche, raffinazione e LNG. Noi guidiamo l'innovazione nelle tecnologie di separazione e purificazione, comprese le soluzioni sostenibili per i biopolimeri e il riciclaggio.

Stiamo cercando un Regional Sales Manager – Regione del Sud con una mentalità imprenditoriale per crescere il nostro business Mass Transfer Components in Canada. Potrai condurre gli sforzi di vendita, costruire forti relazioni con i clienti, e fornire soluzioni su misura che migliorano il successo del cliente. Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di plasmare un territorio dinamico. Unisciti a noi e fai parte di una società che modella il futuro delle industrie di processo con la tecnologia di livello mondiale e l'impegno per l'innovazione e la responsabilità ambientale.
I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:

• Crescita dell'azionamento: Possedere e aumentare l'assunzione di ordini e la redditività in tutta la regione assegnata eseguendo iniziative strategiche di vendita e scoprendo nuove opportunità di business attraverso la prospettiva, la rete e l'analisi del mercato.

• Eseguire un processo di vendita di classe mondiale: gestire l'intero ciclo di vendita — dalla generazione di piombo alla chiusura — utilizzando strumenti CRM per mantenere previsioni accurate, documentare le visite dei clienti e monitorare le opportunità attraverso tutte le fasi di vendita.

• Coinvolgere clienti con competenza tecnica: fornire presentazioni tecniche personalizzate e collaborare con i team interni di Application Engineering e Field Services per sviluppare soluzioni su misura in settori tra cui raffineria, a monte, chimica e carbon Capture.

• Costruire relazioni strategiche: sviluppare e mantenere partnership a lungo termine con i clienti chiave e gli stakeholder, garantendo una crescita continua del business e la soddisfazione del cliente.

• Navigare Complessità Commerciali: Valutare e mitigare i rischi relativi a contratti, prezzi e termini, interfacciandosi con Legale, Contabilità e altri dipartimenti interni per garantire offerte commercialmente solide.

• Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitorare l'attività dei concorrenti e le tendenze del settore, partecipare a fiere e conferenze, e regolarmente riferire sulle prestazioni del territorio per sostenere le strategie di vendita agili.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:

• Hunter Mentality: Sei un go-getter strategico che sa identificare e coinvolgere il cliente ideale. Porti un approccio creativo alla costruzione di relazioni, con esempi reali di come l'hai fatto prima.

• Mindset guidato dalla crescita: eccellete nei mercati di mappatura, identificando lo spazio bianco e sviluppando strategie attuabili per entrare in nuovi segmenti dei clienti. Sei come confortevole sviluppare iniziative di marketing come si sta chiudendo accordi.

• Tenacità e unità: sei motivato da obiettivi e non hai paura di arrotolare le maniche. Inseguite proattivamente nuove opportunità collaborando senza soluzione di continuità con i team applicativi e tecnici per fornire soluzioni orientate al cliente.

• Acume commerciale forte: con 5+ anni in un ruolo di vendita di prima linea, hai imparato l'arte della vendita — dalla generazione di piombo alla chiusura. Conoscete i contratti, negoziate con fiducia e tenete le vostre previsioni CRM affilate e accurate.

• Eccellenza del cliente: Lei è autentico, accessibile e facile da lavorare con — qualcuno i clienti godono di parlare e di fiducia. Il vostro impegno per il servizio crea partnership a lungo termine che alimentano una crescita sostenuta.

• Esperienza industriale-proven: porti almeno cinque anni di successo vendendo attrezzature industriali o servizi in settori petroliferi o correlati, con una solida vendita record.

Nessun visto o permesso di lavoro può essere fornito per questo
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Sulzer Chemtech, ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Massentransfer-, statischen Misch- und Polymerlösungen für die Chemie-, Petrochemie-, Raffinerie- und LNG-Industrie. Wir treiben Innovation in Trenn- und Reinigungstechnologien, einschließlich nachhaltiger Lösungen für Biopolymere und Recycling.

Wir suchen einen Regional Sales Manager – South Region mit einer unternehmerischen Denkweise, um unser Geschäft mit Mass Transfer Components in Kanada zu erweitern. Sie leiten Vertriebsbemühungen, bauen starke Kundenbeziehungen auf und liefern maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die den Kundenerfolg steigern. Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, ein dynamisches Gebiet zu gestalten. Begleiten Sie uns und sind Teil eines Unternehmens, das die Zukunft der Prozessindustrie mit erstklassiger Technologie und ein Engagement für Innovation und Umweltverantwortung prägt.
Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Aufgaben:

• Wachstum vorantreiben: Eigener und wachsender Auftragseingang und Rentabilität in der gesamten Region, indem strategische Vertriebsinitiativen durchgeführt und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten durch Prospektion, Vernetzung und Marktanalyse entdeckt werden.

• Durchführung eines World-Class-Verkaufsprozesses: Verwalten des gesamten Verkaufszyklus – von der Lead-Generation bis zum Abschluss – mit CRM-Tools, um genaue Prognosen zu erhalten, Kundenbesuche zu dokumentieren und Chancen durch alle Verkaufsstufen zu verfolgen.

• Kunden mit technischer Expertise : Liefern Sie kundenspezifische technische Präsentationen und arbeiten Sie mit internen Teams von Application Engineering und Field Services zusammen, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen in allen Bereichen wie Raffinerie, Upstream, Chemical und Carbon Capture zu entwickeln.

• Aufbau strategischer Beziehungen: Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung langfristiger Partnerschaften mit Schlüsselkunden und Interessenvertretern, die ein kontinuierliches Wachstum und Kundenzufriedenheit gewährleisten.

• Navigieren Sie Handelskomplexe : Risiken im Zusammenhang mit Verträgen, Preisen und Konditionen durch Einschaltung von Rechts-, Rechnungswesen und anderen internen Abteilungen, um kommerziell fundierte Geschäfte zu gewährleisten.

• Überwachen Sie die Konkurrenztätigkeit und die Branchentrends, besuchen Sie Messen und Konferenzen und melden Sie regelmäßig über die Leistungsfähigkeit des Territoriums, um agile Vertriebsstrategien zu unterstützen.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:

• Hunter Mentalität: Sie sind ein strategischer Go-Gitter, der weiß, wie man den idealen Kunden identifiziert und engagiert. Sie bringen einen kreativen Ansatz, um Beziehungen aufzubauen, mit realen Beispielen, wie Sie es zuvor getan haben.

• Growth-Driven Mindset: Sie zeichnen sich durch die Mapping-Märkte aus, identifizieren weißen Platz und entwickeln handlungsfähige Strategien, um in neue Kundensegmente zu brechen. Sie sind so bequem, Marketing-Initiativen zu entwickeln, wie Sie Deals schließen.

• Tenacity and Drive : Sie sind von Zielen motiviert und haben keine Angst, Ihre Ärmel hochzurollen. Sie verfolgen proaktiv neue Möglichkeiten und arbeiten nahtlos mit Application und Technical Teams zusammen, um kundenorientierte Lösungen zu liefern.

• Starke kommerzielle Acumen: Mit 5+ Jahren in einer vorgelagerten Verkaufsrolle haben Sie die Kunst des Verkaufs gemeistert – von der Lead-Generation bis zum Abschluss. Sie kennen Verträge, verhandeln mit Vertrauen und halten Ihre CRM Prognosen scharf und genau.

• Customer Excellence : Sie sind authentisch, ansprechbar und einfach zu arbeiten — jemand, der mit dem Gespräch und Vertrauen genießt. Ihr Engagement für den Service schafft langfristige Partnerschaften, die nachhaltiges Wachstum fördern.

• Industrie-Proven-Erfahrung: Sie bringen mindestens fünf Jahre Erfolg Verkauf von Industrieanlagen oder Dienstleistungen in Öl- und Gas- oder verwandten Sektoren, mit einem soliden Track Record-Verkauf.

Ein Visum oder eine Arbeitsgenehmigung kann hierfür nicht vorgesehen werden
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Rejoignez Sulzer Chemtech, leader mondial dans les solutions de transfert de masse, de mélange statique et de polymères pour les industries chimiques, pétrochimiques, de raffinage et de GNL. Nous réalisons l'innovation dans les technologies de séparation et de purification, y compris des solutions durables pour les biopolymères et le recyclage.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur régional des ventes – région du Sud avec un esprit d'entreprise pour développer notre entreprise de composants de transfert de masse au Canada. Vous dirigerez les efforts de vente, établirez de solides relations avec les clients et offrirez des solutions adaptées qui améliorent le succès des clients. Ce rôle offre la possibilité de façonner un territoire dynamique. Rejoignez-nous et faites partie d'une entreprise qui façonne l'avenir des industries de transformation avec une technologie de calibre mondial et un engagement envers l'innovation et la responsabilité environnementale.
Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:

• Favoriser la croissance : Prospection, mise en réseau et analyse du marché : prise de commandes et rentabilités propres et croissantes dans toute la région désignée.

• Exécuter un processus de vente de classe mondiale : gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vente — de la génération de plomb à la fermeture — en utilisant les outils CRM pour maintenir des prévisions précises, documenter les visites des clients et suivre les opportunités à travers toutes les étapes de vente.

• Mobiliser les clients avec une expertise technique : offrir des présentations techniques personnalisées et collaborer avec des équipes internes d'ingénierie d'application et de services sur le terrain pour développer des solutions adaptées à tous les secteurs, y compris la raffinerie, Upstream, Chemical et Carbon Capture.

• Établir des relations stratégiques : Développer et maintenir des partenariats à long terme avec les principaux clients et parties prenantes, en assurant la croissance continue des affaires et la satisfaction de la clientèle.

• Naviguer dans les complexités commerciales : évaluer et atténuer les risques liés aux contrats, aux prix et aux modalités en interférant avec les services juridiques, comptables et autres services internes pour assurer des transactions commercialement saines.

• Stay Ahead of the Curve : Surveiller l'activité des concurrents et les tendances de l'industrie, assister à des salons et conférences, et rendre compte régulièrement des performances sur le territoire pour soutenir des stratégies de vente agiles.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :

• Mentalité de Hunter : Vous êtes un voyeur stratégique qui sait identifier et engager le client idéal. Vous apportez une approche créative pour construire des relations, avec des exemples du monde réel de la façon dont vous l'avez fait avant.

• Growth-Driven Mindset : Vous excellez sur les marchés de la cartographie, l'identification de l'espace blanc et le développement de stratégies actionnables pour percer de nouveaux segments de clients. Vous êtes aussi à l'aise pour développer des initiatives de marketing que vous fermez des affaires.

• Tenacity and Drive : Vous êtes motivé par des cibles et n'avez pas peur de vous retrousser les manches. Vous recherchez proactivement de nouvelles opportunités tout en collaborant de façon transparente avec les équipes Application et Technique pour fournir des solutions axées sur le client.

• Strong Commercial Acumen : Avec 5 ans et plus dans un rôle de vente en première ligne, vous avez maîtrisé l'art de la vente — de la génération de plomb à la fermeture. Vous connaissez les contrats, négociez avec confiance et gardez vos prévisions CRM précises et précises.

• Excellence client : Vous êtes authentique, accessible et facile à travailler avec, quelqu'un aime parler et faire confiance. Votre engagement envers le service crée des partenariats à long terme qui favorisent une croissance soutenue.

• Expérience éprouvée par l'industrie : Vous apportez au moins cinq ans de succès dans la vente d'équipements ou de services industriels dans le secteur du pétrole et du gaz ou dans les secteurs connexes, avec une solide expérience de vente.
